entities.summary: Rudolf Victor "Rudi" Ball was a German ice hockey player. He played for the German national team at several international tournaments, including the 1936 Winter Olympics, where he was notably one of the only German Jewish athletes at the games. He is a member of the IIHF Hall of Fame. Rudi Ball was a athletes & competitors from Berlin (1910-03-17, Berlin–1975-09-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
